rationale.conceptual: The method is a custom quadrupole phonon model with iterative fitting of anharmonic Hamiltonians; it involves building angular-momentum-coupled basis states, computing matrix elements of a scalar-coupled expansion, and solving for parameters and wavefunction coefficients via an iterative scheme described at a high level. Implementing this correctly requires real understanding of nuclear structure theory and spherical tensor algebra, not just plugging into an existing library.
rationale.execution: The pipeline consists of three sequential steps (fitting, energy computation, observable calculation) using standard Python libraries (numpy, scipy). There is no complex orchestration, no multi-source data assembly, and no fragile tooling; the workflow is straightforward.
